detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

BPC-157 (Arginate Salt, Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:
  • Peptide Name: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound-157)
  • Salt Form: Arginine salt
  • Molecular Formula (free peptide): C₆₂H₉₈N₁₆O₂₂
  • Molecular Weight (free peptide): ~1419.5 g/mol
  • Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val
  • Compound Class: Synthetic penta-decapeptide (salt form)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

BPC-157 is a synthetic penta-decapeptide consisting of a 15-amino-acid sequence. This product is supplied in an arginine salt form to support stability and handling characteristics relevant to laboratory research environments. The material is provided in an encapsulated solid format, intended solely as a physical containment and presentation method to facilitate controlled storage, handling, and measurement in research settings. The encapsulated format does not imply any route of administration. BPC-157 (Arginate Salt) is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro investigation of peptide stability and salt-form behavior
  • Laboratory studies examining peptide structure–function relationships
  • Comparative analysis of free-base versus salt-form peptide materials
  • Analytical and mechanistic research involving synthetic regulatory peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Format: Encapsulated solid research peptide (arginine salt)
  • Appearance: White to off-white solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in aqueous laboratory media following capsule removal for analytical use
Compliance Notice:

BPC-157 (Arginate Salt) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
